ai.reality2.pi_light_and_switch.name: Raspberry PI Light and Switch
ai.reality2.pi_light_and_switch.description: A swarm of Bees that act as a light and switch, sending signals to another that can actually turn on and off an LED on a Raspberry PI.  You will also need to run the python client in client-SBC/raaspberry_pi.

ai.reality2.strobe.name: Strobing Light with Switch
ai.reality2.strobe.description: A switch that toggles a strobe light on and off.  The frequency of strobing is set as a variable.

life_coach.name: Life Coach
life_coach.description: Get comprehensive life coaching with activity suggestions, practical advice, and inspirational quotes from Bored API, Advice Slip, and Quotable APIs.
